description: Manual isolated LOCAL grSim stationary contact probe; captured tool output, not a win-rate test.
method: HALT; zero controlled robots; replace ball at (2.8,0)m, robot0 behind ball with heading0; wait0.35s; send flat kick3m/s with zero movement/spinner for20x0.01s; sample latest raw relay ball; zero robot0.
limitations: 90/100mm placements already overlap and push the ball before kick, so their delta is not kick certification. 110mm static placement leaves ball unchanged before kick and produces clear post-command movement. This is model-specific and not calibrated physical ball speed.
